subject: MAP: Squeeze window & procurement cutoff — confirming signature deadline

Subject: MAP draft + suggested signature cutoff (target close v1)

Hi Amelia —

Thanks again for the call yesterday. Per our discussion, attached is a lightweight Mutual Action Plan (MAP_v2.pdf) that lays out the milestones, owners, and a proposed target close date. High-level asks for you:

- Confirm procurement/PO runway (you mentioned internal approval cycles take ~2 weeks once legal signs off)
- Confirm whether your legal team needs the redlined SOW or an executed Master Agreement first
- Flag any mandatory security evidence beyond the snapshot I attached

Draft milestones (proposed):
1) Finalize SOW (StellarData owner: Daniel) — due Tue Dec 14
2) Legal review + redlines (StellarData Legal) — due Fri Dec 18
3) Finance/PO issuance (Procurement) — target Wed Dec 22
4) Execution & signature (by Legal + Redwood exec sign-off) — target Fri Dec 24

Given your year-end close constraints, I flagged a "squeeze window" of Dec 20–24 for signature; if procurement needs an earlier PO cutoff we'll need to accelerate milestone 2.

Next steps I recommend:
- You: confirm if Dec 24 signature is feasible or if procurement needs a hard PO cutoff earlier than Dec 20
- Me: update MAP to reflect exact owners/dates and share a procurement cutoff checklist

Attachments: MAP_v2.pdf, SOW_StellarData.xlsx, procurement-checklist.docx

Best,
Olga Petrov

Subject: Re: MAP draft + suggested signature cutoff (target close v1)

Hi Olga —

Thanks for the MAP. A few notes from procurement/legal:

- Our legal team needs the full SOW redline before procurement will issue a PO. They will not sign an MSA at this stage; they want SOW clarity first.
- Procurement has a finance cutoff of Dec 18 for PO issuance to make our month-end close. If procurement doesn't receive an approved SOW + invoice estimate by EOD Dec 15, the earliest PO will be Jan 5.
- Security is okay with the snapshot you provided but will request an on-demand vendor questionnaire if we proceed.

Bottom line: If we want a signature inside Dec, we need SOW redlines and internal approvals pushed earlier. The "squeeze window" looks like Dec 13–18 for our team.

Can you confirm if Redwood can meet a Dec 15 SOW pushback deadline? That will determine whether we can hit the Dec 18 PO cutoff.

Thanks,
Amelia Zhao
Senior Procurement Manager, StellarData
amelia@stellardata.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 09 Dec 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: RE: MAP draft + suggested signature cutoff (target close v1)

Folks —

Quick internal ops plan to hit StellarData's procurement cutoff window (Dec 13–18):

- Olga: can you commit to turning around a revised SOW (redline incorporated) by EOD Dec 14? That gives procurement one business day (Dec 15) to review before their EOD requirement.
- Markus: legal — can you prioritize a quick sweep for SOW risk items? If there are commercial disputes we'll escalate to me and Priyom; otherwise, a legal sign-off stub should be fine for procurement to proceed to PO.
- Priyom: finance — be ready to accept a T&Cs note for net-30 billing and confirm whether we can issue an invoice/estimate early to help their PO workflow.

If we can deliver on Dec 14 (SOW redline) + legal quick sign-off by Dec 15, procurement should be able to include the PO in their Dec 18 cutoff. If any of those slip, we move to the Jan cycle.

I'll draft a simple procurement-cutover checklist (what procurement needs to issue PO) and send back to Olga to share with Amelia.

Ben Carter
Director, Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: MAP: Squeeze window & procurement cutoff — confirming signature deadline

Amelia —

Thanks for the clarity. Confirming Redwood's plan and updated MAP milestones below (finalized):

Updated milestones (final):
- Dec 14: Revised SOW (Olga) — attached SOW_StellarData.xlsx (redline)
- Dec 15: Legal review & sign-off stub (Markus) — internal sign-off to let procurement proceed
- Dec 16: Finance/invoice estimate provided (Priyom) — procurement can create PO
- Dec 18: Procurement PO issued (StellarData) — procurement cutoff day
- Dec 20: Execution & signature complete (target; allow 2-day buffer)

Procurement-cutover checklist (attached procurement-checklist.docx) — short version: SOW redline, invoice estimate, legal sign-off stub, contact for PO submission (procurement@stellardata.com).

If StellarData confirms acceptance of the Dec 18 PO issuance plan, we'll mark the deal target close date as Dec 20 in HubSpot and prioritize signatures. If procurement cannot meet Dec 18, we will update the MAP and shift target to Jan.

Would you like me to set a 15-minute alignment call with Procurement on Thursday to walk through the checklist?

Best,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
